attributes.name: promo section container style
attributes.definition: How the promotional/campaign block is contained and shaped on the page.

values.definition: Edge-to-edge band spanning the page width, typically short.
Inset card-like panel with rounded corners.
Different treatment or no promo block.

attributes.name: promo CTA button shape
attributes.definition: Shape of the call-to-action button in the promo block.

values.definition: Square, slightly rounded or other button shape.
No CTA button in the promo.

attributes.name: promo background color treatment
attributes.definition: Color family of the promo block background.

values.definition: Deep navy or dark blue background.

attributes.name: promo accompanying imagery
attributes.definition: Whether the promo block includes a photo and how it is shaped.

values.definition: Photograph with rounded corners inside the promo.
Promo is text and button only.
Image present with other shape or treatment.
